title: 分配與比
Sharing in a ratio
question: 兩班按 2:3 分配 45 本新書。較少的一班應得多少本？
Two classes share 45 new books in the ratio 2:3. How many go to the smaller share?
options: 18 books
共五份，每份九本；兩份是十八本。
There are five parts of nine books; two parts give 18.
22.5 books
平均分配忽略了 2:3 的條件。
Equal sharing ignores the stated 2:3 ratio.
30 books
2:3 的分母是兩份加三份，不是三份。
The whole contains 2+3 parts, not 3 parts.
takeaway: 按比分配，先求總份數，再求每份大小。
Find the total number of ratio parts before calculating each share.

title: 周界的代數模型
An algebraic perimeter
question: 長方形園圃長為 (x+3) 米、闊為 x 米，周界 30 米。闊是多少？
A rectangular garden is (x+3)m long and x m wide. Its perimeter is 30 m. What is its width?
options: 6 米
6 m
只相加一次長和闊，算的是半周界。
Adding one length and one width gives half the perimeter.
這相當於把長方形誤當成正方形。
This incorrectly treats the rectangle as a square.
takeaway: 用圖形關係建立方程，並把答案代回原條件。
Build an equation from the geometry and check the solution in the original conditions.

title: 平均數與極端值
Mean and an extreme value
question: 五天借書量是 8、9、9、10、44。要描述一般一天的借書量，哪個說法最合理？
Daily loans are 8, 9, 9, 10, 44. Which statement best describes a typical day?
options: 中位數 9 較能反映大部分日子；平均數是 16
Median 9 represents most days better; the mean is 16
44拉高平均數；中位數取排序後中央值。
44 pulls the mean upward; the median is the middle ordered value.
平均數 16 表示至少三天借出 16 本
Mean 16 means at least three days had 16 loans
平均數不表示多數觀察值必須等於它。
A mean need not equal most observations.
刪去 44，因為大數一定是錯誤
Delete 44 because a large value must be wrong
極端值可能是真實活動日，不能未查證便刪除。
An unusual event may be real; investigate before deleting it.
takeaway: 選統計量時要看分佈；極端值不等於錯誤資料。
Choose summaries with the distribution in mind; an extreme value is not automatically an error.

title: 百分率的基準
Changing percentage bases
question: 一件售價 $200 的校隊外套先減價20%，再按減價後價錢加價20%。最後售價是多少？
A $200 team jacket is discounted 20%, then increased 20% from the discounted price. What is the final price?
options: 200×0.8×1.2=192; the percentage bases differ.
減價與加價的百分率相同，不表示金額相同。
Equal percentage rates do not mean equal cash changes.
160只是完成第一次減價的售價。
160 is the price after the first change only.
takeaway: 連續百分率變化應相乘，不應直接互相抵消。
Multiply successive percentage factors rather than cancelling their rates.

title: 票價的聯立方程
Simultaneous ticket equations
question: 兩張成人票及三張學生票共 $84；一張成人票及兩張學生票共 $48。學生票是多少？
Two adult and three student tickets cost $84; one adult and two student tickets cost $48. What is a student ticket price?
options: 第二式乘二後減第一式，得一張學生票$12。
Double the second equation and subtract the first to obtain$12.
$24是代回方程後得到的成人票價。
$24 is the adult price after substitution.
總價除五假設兩種票價相同。
Dividing 84 by 5 assumes both ticket types cost the same.
takeaway: 聯立方程要同時符合兩項條件。
A simultaneous solution must satisfy both conditions.

title: 坡道是否達標
Testing a ramp model
question: 設計規格要求斜邊長與垂直高度的比至少為13:5。一條直角三角形坡道高0.5米、水平長1.2米。只按這項規格，判斷如何？
A design requires slope length: vertical height to be at least 13:5. A right-triangle ramp rises 0.5 m over 1.2 m horizontally. Considering only this specification, what follows?
options: 剛好達標：斜邊1.3米，比為13:5
Exactly meets it: slope 1.3 m gives 13:5
√(0.5²+1.2²)=1.3；此題不代表真實無障礙法規。
Pythagoras gives 1.3 m. This hypothetical specification is not an accessibility regulation.
不達標：水平長與高度比是12:5
Fails because horizontal length:height is 12:5
規格指定斜邊長，不是水平長。
The specification refers to slope length, not horizontal length.
Passes because slope=1.2+0.5=1.7 m
直角三角形的斜邊不能直接把兩直角邊相加。
The hypotenuse is not the sum of the two perpendicular sides.
takeaway: 先辨清模型中的量，再用勾股定理驗證。
Identify the quantities in the model before applying Pythagoras.

title: 相似圖形的面積
Area under enlargement
question: 校園地圖等比例放大，所有長度變為原來的1.5倍。一個原面積40平方釐米的區域，放大後面積是多少？
A campus map is enlarged uniformly by a length factor 1.5. An area was 40 cm². What is its enlarged area?
options: 90 平方釐米
90 cm²
面積放大倍數為1.5²=2.25。
The area factor is 1.5²=2.25.
60 平方釐米
60 cm²
1.5是長度倍數；面積涉及兩個方向。
1.5 is the length factor; area scales in two dimensions.
100 平方釐米
100 cm²
面積倍數不是1+1.5。
The area factor is not 1+1.5.
takeaway: 相似圖形長度比為k，面積比為k²。
Similar figures with length ratio k have area ratio k².

title: 不放回抽樣
Sampling without replacement
question: 袋中有三枚紅棋和兩枚藍棋，隨機抽兩枚且不放回。兩枚都是藍色的概率是多少？
A bag contains 3 red and 2 blue counters. Two are drawn randomly without replacement. What is the probability both are blue?
options: (2/5)×(1/4)=1/10; the second draw has fewer counters.
這是假設第一次抽到藍棋後放回。
This assumes the first blue counter is replaced.
這只計算了第一枚是藍色。
This accounts only for the first blue draw.
takeaway: 不放回抽樣會改變下一次抽取的條件。
Sampling without replacement changes the conditions of the next draw.

title: 量度誤差的界限
Bounds of measurement
question: 長方形板的長和闊分別量得12釐米及8釐米，均四捨五入至最接近的釐米。其真正面積的上界是多少？
A rectangular board is measured as 12 cm by 8 cm, each rounded to the nearest centimetre. What is the upper bound of its true area?
options: 106.25 平方釐米（不包括）
106.25 cm² (exclusive)
Length<12.5 and width<8.5, so area<106.25.
96 平方釐米
96 cm²
96是用顯示數值算出的估計，不是上界。
96 is the estimate from displayed values, not an upper bound.
117 平方釐米
117 cm²
四捨五入至整數的誤差界限為0.5，而不是1。
Rounding to the nearest unit gives a half-unit bound, not one unit.
takeaway: 運算前先寫量度值的上下界，避免把估計當精確值。
Establish measurement bounds before calculation instead of treating rounded values as exact.

title: 二次方程與情境
Interpreting quadratic roots
question: 長方形花圃闊x米、長(x+2)米，面積48平方米。方程有根6和−8，哪個可用？
A garden is x m wide and (x+2)m long with area 48 m². The equation has roots 6 and −8. Which is admissible?
options: 只有 x=6
Only x=6
Lengths must be positive; 6×8=48.
兩個根都可用
Both roots
代數根仍要符合花圃長度的情境限制。
Algebraic roots must also satisfy the contextual length constraint.
只有 x=−8
Only x=−8
負長度不符合題目的實際量。
A negative length is invalid in this model.
takeaway: 求根後須檢查定義域和情境限制。
After solving, check the domain and contextual restrictions.

title: 直線交點的意義
Interpreting a line intersection
question: 打印店A收費為$30+$0.20n，B為$0.35n，n是頁數。何時A開始比B便宜？
Printing shop A charges $30+$0.20 n and B charges $0.35 n for n pages. When is A cheaper?
options: 30<0.15n，所以超過200頁才較便宜。
30<0.15 n, so A is cheaper above 200 pages.
固定費用令A在少量打印時較貴。
The fixed fee makes A more expensive for smaller jobs.
200頁時兩店同價，尚未是較便宜。
At 200 pages the costs are equal, not cheaper.
takeaway: 交點表示同價；比較便宜與否需要解不等式。
The intersection means equal cost; cheaper-than comparisons require an inequality.

title: 指數模型的限制
Limits of an exponential model
question: 模型N=100×2ᵗ把影片每日觀看量假定為前一天兩倍。第5天預測3200。哪項新證據最直接削弱模型長期適用性？
The model N=100×2ᵗ assumes daily views double. It predicts 3200 on day 5. Which new evidence most directly weakens its long-term use?
options: 可接觸的觀眾有限，而且新增觀看率已下降
The reachable audience is limited and growth has slowed
固定倍增需要持續成立的條件；受眾飽和會破壞它。
Constant doubling requires persistent conditions; audience saturation undermines them.
模型在首五天的預測與觀察吻合。
Its predictions matched observations for the first five days.
短期吻合支持短期適用，沒有直接反駁長期增長假設。
A short-term match supports short-term fit; it does not directly refute long-term growth.
首日瀏覽量其實是 120，而非 100。
The initial number of views was 120 rather than 100.
這要求修正起始值，卻未直接檢驗每天倍增可否長期持續。
This changes the starting value but does not directly test whether daily doubling can continue.
takeaway: 計算正確不等於模型在所有時間都有效。
Correct calculation does not guarantee a model remains valid over time.

title: 相切與半徑
Tangents and radii
question: 圓心O到圓外點P距離13釐米，半徑OT=5釐米，PT在T點與圓相切。PT長多少？
OP=13 cm from centre O to external point P; radius OT=5 cm and PT is tangent at T. Find PT.
options: 12 釐米
12 cm
半徑垂直切線，PT=√(13²−5²)=12。
Radius and tangent are perpendicular; PT=√(13²−5²)=12.
8 釐米
8 cm
13−5忽略了OT與PT互相垂直。
13−5 ignores the right angle between OT and PT.
OP是斜邊，求PT須相減平方。
OP is the hypotenuse, so subtract the squared radius.
takeaway: 先利用圓的幾何性質，再選合適計算關係。
Use the circle property to establish the geometry before calculating.

title: 條件概率的分母
The conditional denominator
question: 40名學生中，18人參加音樂社、15人參加美術社、6人兩者都參加。已知隨機選中的學生參加美術社，他也參加音樂社的概率？
Of 40 students, 18 join music, 15 join art and 6 join both. Given that a randomly selected student joins art, what is the probability they also join music?
options: 已知參加美術社，把樣本空間限於15人。
Conditioning on art restricts the sample space to 15 students.
這是隨機學生同時參加兩社的無條件概率。
This is the unconditional probability of joining both clubs.
這是已知參加音樂社時的反向條件概率。
This reverses the condition by starting with music members.
takeaway: 條件概率先限制樣本空間；條件不能隨意交換。
Conditional probability restricts the sample space; reversing the condition changes the question.

title: 標準差與變換
Transforming spread
question: 一組分數平均60、標準差8。每個分數都按 y=1.5x+10 轉換。新平均和標準差是甚麼？
Scores have mean 60 and standard deviation 8. Every score becomes y=1.5 x+10. What are the new mean and standard deviation?
options: 平均100，標準差12
Mean 100, standard deviation 12
平均作同樣線性變換；加常數不改變分散程度。
The mean transforms linearly; adding a constant does not change spread.
平均100，標準差22
Mean 100, standard deviation 22
標準差不能加上10；所有數值同移不改變距離。
Do not add 10 to the standard deviation; shifting all values preserves distances.
平均90，標準差12
Mean 90, standard deviation 12
標準差算對，但平均漏了加10。
The spread is correct, but the mean omitted the added 10.
takeaway: 平移改變中心，縮放同時改變中心及分散程度。
A shift changes location; scaling also changes spread.

title: 對數與倍增時間
Logarithms and growth time
question: 儲量模型V=500×1.08ᵗ，t以年計。求V首次達1000的連續時間，應計哪個式子？
For V=500×1.08ᵗ with t in years, which expression gives the continuous time when V first reaches 1000?
options: 先除500得1.08ᵗ=2，再取同底對數。
Divide by 500 to obtain 1.08ᵗ=2, then take logarithms with the same base.
這漏除了初始值500。
This omits division by the initial amount 500.
這把複合增長誤當固定量的線性增加。
This treats compound growth as a fixed linear increase.
takeaway: 未知數在指數時，先整理比例再使用對數。
When the unknown is an exponent, isolate the growth ratio before using logarithms.

title: 限制條件與最佳值
Optimising under constraints
question: 製作x個袋和y本冊，限制為x≥0、y≥0、x+y≤10、2x+y≤14。收益P=5x+3y。在可行頂點(0,0)、(0,10)、(4,6)、(7,0)中，哪點最佳？
Make x bags and y booklets with x, y≥0, x+y≤10, 2 x+y≤14. Revenue P=5 x+3 y. Which feasible vertex is best: (0, 0), (0, 10), (4, 6), (7, 0)?
options: (4, 6), revenue 38
The objective values are 0, 30, 38, 35; 38 is greatest.
(7, 0), revenue 35
每袋收益較高，不表示全製袋的總收益最高。
A larger unit return does not make an all-bag plan optimal.
(0, 10), revenue 30
產量最多的一點不一定有最高收益。
The largest item count need not maximise revenue.
takeaway: 比較可行頂點的目標函數，而非只看單價或產量。
Compare objective values at feasible vertices, not only prices or output counts.

title: 統計比較的反轉
When pooled rates mislead
question: 方法A：基礎題90/100答對、進階題1/10；方法B：基礎題19/20、進階題20/100。A總正確率較高。哪項評估最合理？
Method A: 90/100 basic and 1/10 advanced correct. B: 19/20 basic and 20/100 advanced correct. A has a higher pooled rate. Which evaluation is strongest?
options: B在兩類題均較高；兩者題型比例不同，須標準化比較
B is better within each type; standardise the different task mixes
基礎90%對95%、進階10%對20%；混合權重可反轉結論。
Basic rates 90% vs 95%, advanced 10% vs 20%; different weights can reverse the pooled comparison.
A在每一類題都較好
A is better on every task type
分組計算顯示兩類都是B較高。
Calculating within each type shows B is higher in both.
只要總題數不同，所有正確率都不能比較
No rates can be compared if totals differ
比率容許不同樣本量；此處關鍵是題型組成及不確定性。
Rates can compare unequal sample sizes; task mix and uncertainty are the issues here.
takeaway: 總平均會受組成影響；比較表現須檢查分組及權重。
Pooled performance depends on composition; inspect groups and weights.
